title: Analysis request
description: One proposed scRNA-seq analysis, as the controller stores and returns it. Every field name here is the same string in services/controller/app/domain.py, in apps/web/lib/controllerTypes.ts and in the intake conversation. `analysis` holds the public vocabulary, which services/controller/app/domain.py::to_executor_config maps to executor config keys; it is never passed through as a config dict.

request_id.description: One proposed analysis request. Never a conversation id and never a scientific run id.

conversation_id.description: The CopilotKit conversation this draft was prepared in. A conversation may prepare many requests; it is not a run identity and is never used as a checkpoint thread key.

input_ref.description: A server-side reference, never a filesystem path. `dataset:` names a catalog entry; `local:` is an opaque token this server issued for a path that passed its allowlist. Only the controller can resolve either.

project.description: What the report titles itself with.

species.description: Resolves the reference genome and the QC gene sets. Validated against src/species.py, including its aliases.

research_question.description: What this analysis is for, in the requester's own words. Recorded with the request and shown at review. It is never converted into a config value: it can only cause the intake to ask a question, never to set a parameter.

study_design_ref.description: A server-side manifest reference. A manifest path cannot be supplied directly by a caller or a model.

config_digest.description: Taken over exactly what decides the execution. Confirmation must carry it back; a mismatch is refused so a draft cannot be confirmed under a version nobody read.

missing_questions.description: Information the request needs and does not have. A required entry blocks confirmation. These are questions rather than defaults on purpose: a filled-in species or manifest produces a request that looks complete and describes an analysis nobody asked for.

validation_errors.description: This request is wrong and nothing can start. Distinct from missing_questions, which mean it is incomplete.

warnings.description: This request will run, and here is what it will do that may not have been meant — a gate it will stop at, a hint that is only a hint.

unsupported.description: Analyses asked for that this workflow has no step for. Reported rather than silently dropped, and never presented as supported.

scientific_run_id.description: Set at confirmation, before the worker starts, so a crash between queueing and running leaves a run directory the job already claims. Distinct from request_id, conversation_id and job_id.

analysisSettings.description: The public analysis vocabulary. Only these names exist; anything else is a validation error rather than a config key that reaches the executor.

integration_mode.description: Executor config key: integration_mode. `harmony` requires study_design_ref: correction runs on the manifest's technical_batch and nothing else.

celltypist_model.description: Executor config key: celltypist_model. Left unset, annotate_cells lists its candidates and stops at a gate rather than guessing a model.

scmayomap_tissue.description: Executor config key: scmayomap_tissue. Left unset, cross_check_annotation lists its candidates and stops.

annotation.description: annotate_cells is on the mainline and every route that produces a report runs it. `false` is reported as unsupported rather than accepted and ignored.

doublet_detection.description: detect_doublets is on the mainline. `false` is reported as unsupported.
